production_change.reason: Accuracy weights were not written into the production models. Betting thresholds were not tuned.

audit.affects: Expected minutes, which scale shot volume, rebound chances, and assist chances.
audit.notes: Blends season, last-5, and last-10 minutes. Starters have a floor. A back-to-back multiplies minutes by 0.94. Blowout risk multiplies minutes by 1 - 0.06 * risk. Teammate-absence minutes are added once.

audit.affects: Minutes and usage. It is not applied again as a separate scoring multiplier.
audit.notes: The accuracy experiment does not add another blowout term. Historical pregame spreads were not used to invent a second adjustment.

audit.where: UsageModel and the points/threes volume factor
audit.affects: Shot volume only when tonight's usage differs from the player's own usage. Season usage is already inside season field-goal attempts.
audit.notes: Teammate-absence usage_vacuum is a multiplier. Historical injury reports are not available, so backtests leave that multiplier at 1.

audit.where: Points, assists, rebounds, and threes models
audit.affects: Mean. About 80% is opportunities times conversion. About 20% is a minute-scaled rate prior.
audit.notes: Points use field-goal attempts and points per attempt. Rebounds use rebound chances and a secure rate. Assists need potential assists. Threes use attempt rate and make rate.

audit.affects: Opportunity volume. A missing pace widens the standard deviation and is labeled a fallback.
audit.notes: Model A holds pace at the league average so pace is not confused with positional defense.

audit.affects: Scoring efficiency, partially. It is not multiplied on top of fantasy points allowed.
audit.notes: The factor is the opponent rating divided by the league rating, clamped.

audit.affects: A partial move of volume or efficiency. Points use 55% of the points-allowed gap. Threes use attempt volume when the slot is measured.
audit.notes: Fantasy points allowed are not applied to points, rebounds, assists, or threes. January and February tests found this adjustment hurt probability accuracy.

audit.affects: Minutes and usage on the live slate when current injuries are known.
audit.notes: BALLDONTLIE injuries are current-only. Historical backtests do not invent them.

audit.affects: The probability of a line, not the mean. Pace fallback widens the standard deviation.
audit.notes: PRA uses a correlated sum of points, rebounds, and assists. Pushes are graded as pushes.

audit.affects: The live displayed probability after the statistical probability is computed.
audit.notes: The accuracy experiment does not blend sportsbook prices into its probabilities. No-vig prices are an external benchmark only.

missing: Game-level potential assists are not on GET /nba/v2/stats/advanced. Season passing averages include potential_ast, but a 2025-26 season total includes later games and is not used.
Historical injury and lineup reports are not available. Usage and minutes vacuums stay neutral.
BALLDONTLIE positions are G/F/C and hybrids, mapped explicitly onto five positions. That mapping is uncertain.
Pregame blowout spread is not on the box score. The experiment does not add a second blowout adjustment.
